title: 01_event_lift_reproduction
interpretation: The event-free SBML core run by Tellurium, with the infection (E_infect) and TLR hysteresis (E_tlrOn/Off) lifted out of the model into general viva-impulse Steps (a ScheduledEvent and a ThresholdSwitch) coupled through TelluriumImpulseBridge, reproduces the full event-driven model (same proto_valve continuous core, events relocated): hemodynamics to ~1e-03 relative, blood pathogen to 20.4%. The residual is the tick-quantization of the infection timing — the ScheduledEvent fires at the first 10 s tick >= infectionStart, vs the SBML event's exact root-find. The discrete events are now explicit, inspectable and swappable at the composite level without editing the SBML.
